attributes.readMe:
# Score Field

## Summary
A NumberField subclass rendering a 1–5 star picker (edit), a star row (embedded), and a compact `★ n` (atom). Used for interview ratings, candidate overall scores, and vendor performance.

## Import
```ts
import { ScoreField } from './score-field';
```

## Usage
```ts
@field interviewScore = contains(ScoreField);
```

## Template Usage
```hbs
<@fields.interviewScore />
```
